section: Judge.me star rating above product title
commit_message: feat(pdp): add rating block above product title
acceptance_criteria: The shared PDP renders the native star rating block flush left, below the vendor text and above the product title
Products with a populated Judge.me reviews.rating metafield show stars, average, and review count in that position
Products with no reviews.rating metafield render no rating row (no broken empty state)
A '| [count] Reviews' link renders after the rating count and, on click, smooth-scrolls the Judge.me review widget section into view accounting for the sticky header
